authority_boundary: DAD control planes provide reviewed guidance, candidate notices, and approved enrollment surfaces. Target repos retain local source authority and normal recurring DAD writes are mailbox-only.

control_planes.name: DAD Library And Signal Graph
control_planes.authority_boundary: DAD library matches are deterministic candidate recommendations; local repos decide adoption.

control_planes.name: DAD Mail Center
control_planes.authority_boundary: Candidate-only message transport; local repo review decides adoption.

control_planes.name: DAD Exceptions Lake
control_planes.authority_boundary: Exception records are append-only candidate evidence and safe metadata. DAD may classify, cluster, and recommend learning, but source repos or named humans own final fix status and promotion.

control_planes.name: Reusable Asset Library
control_planes.authority_boundary: Asset pointers and update notices are suggestions until adopted locally.

control_planes.name: Coding Harness Library
control_planes.authority_boundary: Harnesses are candidate improvement workflows until reviewed and validated in the target repo.

control_planes.name: Professional Research Layer
control_planes.authority_boundary: Professional research is fallback candidate evidence after DAD lookup. It may create pointer-only intake, harness candidates, or fix-outcome records, but it cannot promote external content, copy leaked material, or mutate downstream repos without review.

control_planes.name: Agent Skill Library
control_planes.authority_boundary: Skill checkout pointers do not install plugins, copy full skills, or override local agent instructions without approval.

control_planes.name: Template Library
control_planes.authority_boundary: Template update notices are candidate guidance; managed blocks require approved enrollment apply/update.

control_planes.name: Architecture References
control_planes.authority_boundary: Architecture recommendations are advisory and must be checked against local repo constraints.

control_planes.name: Repo Enrollment
control_planes.authority_boundary: Full governance enrollment applies only to reviewed policy entries with approval IDs; recurring operation remains mailbox-only.

control_planes.name: Coding And Test Parity Guidance
control_planes.authority_boundary: Rust or shadow-layer test guidance remains candidate-only until parity is proven and accepted locally.

control_planes.name: Governance Maps
control_planes.authority_boundary: Governance maps describe authority dependencies; they do not transfer authority to DAD.

control_planes.name: Data Maps
control_planes.authority_boundary: Data maps track movement and sensitivity boundaries; public/private release gates remain human-governed.

control_planes.name: Learning And Postflight Loops
control_planes.authority_boundary: Lessons, review-lane findings, and asset/harness scout outputs are bounded candidate learning unless reviewed and context-matched.
